dialogues.speaker: Kira
dialogues.text: According to instructions from the Akademiya, the latest marine conditions...

dialogues.speaker: Kira
dialogues.text: I'm a local fisherman. Other than fishing, I'm also a contact for the researchers sent by the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Kira
dialogues.text: The Akademiya would take a portion of our catch in exchange for helping us fishermen to determine the distribution pattern of marine life and plan fishing seasons and moratoriums.

dialogues.speaker: Kira
dialogues.text: It's a good deal for us to exchange some fish for the assurance of bountiful hauls and safe voyage.

dialogues.speaker: Kira
dialogues.text: I remember it was calm one day, but a Scribe passing through pointed at how odd that sort of tranquility was and saved us from a stormy sail.

dialogues.speaker: Kira
dialogues.text: That only convinced us to follow the Akademiya even more, and we hope the relationship will continue.

dialogues.speaker: Kira
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Only by understanding the sea will you get to enjoy its treasures.
